description: This file defines the SubjectsModified event class, which is part of the Eclipse Ditto project. It represents an event emitted after subjects associated with a policy are modified, including methods for JSON serialization/deserialization, object construction, and accessors for its properties.

classes.name: SubjectsModified
classes.description: An immutable event class representing the modification of subjects within a policy in the Eclipse Ditto framework, supporting JSON serialization/deserialization, equality, and builder methods.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a SubjectsModified instance with typed PolicyId, label, subjects, revision, timestamp, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a SubjectsModified instance from a JSON string or JSON object, deserializing the event.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label associated with the modified subjects.

methods.name: getSubjects
methods.description: Returns the Subjects object that was modified.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Returns a new instance with an updated revision number.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated DittoHeaders.
